params.body:
## Why

Since the cutover every delivery to `backend.flexlease.rent` has been a 404 (321 of 321) and every one to `okasie.be` a 503 (31 of 31, several dealers). The Koppelingen pane showed only the last status per receiver, so it took someone opening the page to notice; nobody is alerted.

## What

- **`App\Support\WebhookStreaks`**: per receiver the tail of failed deliveries since the last success (a 2xx without error): count, first and last failure, last success. A failure is status >= 400 or no status with an error; a 3xx neither breaks nor lengthens the streak. A receiver is **down** when the streak is >= 5 **and** spans >= 1 hour, so one bad answer or a burst during a receiver's deploy does not alarm. One query for any number of receivers (`leftJoinSub` on the last-success derived table, conditional aggregates); bounded by the 30-day prune.
- **Elixir app-health** (`GET /api/elixir`): new section `extra.webhooks` via `App\Elixir\WebhookReceiversProbe`, registered in `config/elixir.php` next to `photos`: `receivers: [{id, host, dealer: 'alle'|name, streak, since, lastFailure, lastOk, down}]`, `down: n`, `threshold: {minFailures: 5, minSpanMinutes: 60}`. Facts only, no receiver is called.
- **Koppelingen pane**: under the receiver's scope line the streak reads "321 op rij mislukt sinds 15/09 20:43" (with ", laatst gelukt 18/09/2026 07:00" when there was a success); red (`ui-status-text--error`) and the status chip `ui-badge--danger` when down, the chip `ui-badge--warning` for a failing last delivery that is not (yet) a down streak. Same one-query pattern, no N+1, no CSS changes.
- **Docs**: R P3-13.6 (streak + pane), R P3-13.7 (app-health section), P3-4.4 points to the delivery row. `php bin/rules-sources` prints "Geen problemen".
- **Tests**: `tests/Feature/WebhookStreaksTest.php` (`@rule P3-13.6`/`P3-13.7`): mixed statuses, all ok, all failing (down / burst / four over a day / silent), null status with and without a reason, the health payload, the pane text. `Http::fake()` throughout, `Http::assertNothingSent()` on the endpoint.

## Suggested verdict in Elixir

Facet `webhooks` on `extra.webhooks.down`: `down >= 1` receiver = "deze week" (`WEBHOOK_RECEIVER_DOWN`), `down == 0` = ok. The receivers list gives the host and the dealer for the finding text; `threshold` says what the app counted as down, so the verdict can name it.

## Screenshots

`.playwright-mcp/webhook-health/koppelingen-1440.png`, `.playwright-mcp/webhook-health/koppelingen-390.png` (seeded with the production picture: flexlease 321 x 404, okasie 31 x 503, Hexon mostly 200, yourdailydrive all 200).

## Hot files

None touched.
